affected_subject.reason: Identifies _decreaseFeeShares/_endRewards in LaunchToken and downstream endRewards in Launchpad/Distributor.

trigger_or_action.reason: Concrete condition totalFeeShare==0 && !unlocked triggers _endRewards, including sole-buyer sell scenario.

direct_effect.reason: Rewards cannot end when they should, and sole buyer cannot sell because pair's endRewardsAccrual is called before pair exists.

safety_relation_basis.reason: Expected end-rewards condition (unlocked and all buyers transferred) vs actual condition (totalFeeShare==0 and not unlocked) gives expected-vs-actual state relation.

summary: Report identifies the affected functions, the wrong trigger condition, concrete effects (rewards not ending, sole buyer unable to sell), and the expected-vs-actual condition mismatch, sufficient to attempt formalization.
